subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When a review completes, the reviewer shall persist the report — human rendering plus the machine payload, carrying the reviewed revision — on the proposal itself, medium-appropriately (a marker-block comment on GitHub; a typed decision-record on Carina), surviving the session.
rationale: D-9: the corpus is the product; implementation context is disposable, findings are not
fit_criterion: every dogfood proposal carries the retrievable machine payload with the reviewed-revision field; a fixture parses findings + dispositions back from both media byte-faithfully
